sloka: तथा ऽ ऽदित्यौ महावीर्यौ त्वष्टा पूषा च दंशितौ ।निंर्भयौ सह सैन्येन तदा प्राविशतां रणे ।। ७.२७.३५ ॥
transliteration: tathā ' 'dityau mahāvīryau tvaṣṭā pūṣā ca daṁśitau ।niṁrbhayau saha sainyena tadā prāviśatāṁ raṇe ।। 7.27.35 ॥

translations.english: Likewise, the two Adityas of great valor, Tvashta and Pushan, armored and fearless, then entered the battle with their army.
